shortDescription: Manage snap schedule to configure the desired schedule of snapshot creation.

options.name: name
options.description: Snapshot schedule's name. Serves as unique identifier across all snapshot schedules.

options.name: recurrences
options.description: The recurrence rules we want to set for the snapshot schedule.

options.name: state
options.description: The desired state of the snapshot schedule object. Use C(absent) to ensure the snapshot schedule will be absent from the API and C(present) to ensure snapshot schedule will remain present on the API.
